sources.title: Clarity in League
sources.author: Riot Games
sources.actuallyRead: Gameplay should be conveyed clearly; preserve importance hierarchy and reduce accumulated visual noise. Existing silhouette remains identifiable.
sources.application: Self, current factual reading and selected action dominate the question/ending stage; decoration does not create rewards/state.

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline112 UI navigation
sources.author: Microsoft Game Dev
sources.actuallyRead: Navigation and repeated controls should be consistent; focus moves predictably; keyboard access matters.
sources.application: Retain original chapter/pager/detail/all-choice callbacks and confirmation/focus return; preselection stays readonly.
